brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage before the forecast heat event, clearing any obstruction exceeding one quarter of the free area as instructed in SOP-015. Additionally, because this ageing unit cannot be attended or if it faces sustained exposure, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed by MG-023. Ensure all de-ratings are recorded with their reason, value, and period in accordance with MG-021.
